defs.def: the process of improving or developing, or of getting nearer to achieving or completing sth 进步；进展；进程

ex.s: I decided that I wanted to learn as many words as I could and started marking every entry I looked up with a pencil to measure my progress.
ex.t: 那时我决心要尽可能多地学单词，并开始用铅笔标记每一个查过的词条，以此来衡量自己的进步。

ex.s: Humility should be a driving force for human progress.
ex.t: 谦逊应当成为人类进步的驱动力。

ex.s: To keep records of her progress.
ex.t: 为了记录自己的进展。

ex.s: But that’s progress, I guess.”
ex.t: 但这就是进步吧，我想。"

ex.s: It should speed up its progress.
ex.t: 它应该加快发展速度。

ex.s: Failure can lead to progress.
ex.t: 成功导致过度自信

ex.s: It’s partly that his writings rode a wave of social, political and scientific progress.
ex.t: 部分原因在于他的著作乘上了社会、政治和科学进步的浪潮。

ex.s: Yet instead of being discouraged by my   54   progress, I was excited.
ex.t: 然而，我没有因为进展____而气馁，反而很兴奋。

ex.s: We cannot stop the march of progress.
ex.t: 我们无法阻止进步的进程。

ex.s: The rapid progress in her ability.
ex.t: 学习试题是如何出的以及基于什么内容

ex.s: To frame his story, Klein creates the character of Ned, a fictional witness to the progress brought about by the steams and electric revolutions in America during one man's lifetime.
ex.t: 为了构建他的故事，Klein创造了Ned这个角色，一个见证美国在一个人的有生之年因蒸汽和电力革命而取得进展的虚构人物。

ex.s: Make sure to give each other encouragement and take photos or make videos to record your progress.
ex.t: 一定要互相鼓励，并拍照或录像记录你们的进展。

ex.s: SENIOR HIGH QUESTIONNAIRE Now you’ve been at senior high for over a year, I’d like to know your progress and plans for the future.
ex.t: 高中问卷 现在你上高中已经一年多了，我想了解你的进展和未来计划。

ex.s: DX Sports Watch Are you looking for a sports watch that can help you keep track of your fitness and chart your training progress?
ex.t: DX运动手表您是否正在寻找一款可以帮助您跟踪健身情况并记录训练进度的运动手表？

defs.def: movement forwards or towards a place 前进；行进
to improve or develop over a period of time; to make progress 进步；改进；进展

ex.s: Progress can be slow, and you’ll wonder if it’s all sinking in.
ex.t: 进步可能很慢，你会怀疑这一切是否真的被他们吸收了。

ex.s: This can be a work in progress rather than a completed piece.
ex.t: 这可以是创作中的作品，而不是已完成的最终稿。

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 问题是，为『塑形』而进行的规律锻炼需要持续且大量的努力——而这一切只是为了渐进的进步和不确定的回报。

ex.s: •Weekly progress reports for all pair meetings
ex.t: •每次双人见面会提交周进度报告

ex.s: It would be impossible to progress in anything, after all, without taking the occasional misstep.
ex.t: 毕竟，不偶尔走错步，任何事都不可能进步。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: ·Community Booster: Guiding you to develop innovative solutions for real-world challenges and create transformative progress to benefit all communities
ex.t: 社区助推器：引导你为现实世界的挑战开发创新解决方案，创造变革性进步以造福所有社区。

ex.s: Progress check (√or ×) Reflections Day 1 Day 2 Day 3 2 Carry out your self-improvement plan.
ex.t: 进度检查（√或×） 反思 第一天 第二天 第三天 2 执行你的自我提升计划。

to go forward in time （时间上）推移，流逝
